A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (19 February 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Jedi-D-gravityshadow-PC-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Gravity Shadow (Reflections III Foil)]] (31 October 2001): The game text changes: “has just begun to move” becomes “is about to move”; “draw destiny” becomes “target that starship and its highest-ability pilot. Draw destiny”; “ability of highest-ability pilot” becomes “pilot's ability”; “must return to original location and may not move this turn” becomes “may not move this turn”; “that pilot's ability” becomes “pilot's ability”. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in the black lower border.

The Reflections III foil (a photograph of the printed card) and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
